strings: Hello. I am here to guide the dead cats of c_n into StarClan.
Wants to sob at the thought of never fading.
Wonders if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} made the right choice in becoming a guide.
Happily greets all the new cats {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'s let into StarClan.
Shudders at the thought of dragging cats down to the Dark Forest.
Frowns when the medicine cat gets {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} prophecy wrong.
Frowns when the medicine cat gets {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} omen wrong.
Prepares to send a prophecy to the medicine cat.
Yelps when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} almost crosses the StarClan border into the Dark Forest.
